name: Bard Choreographer
body:
Choreographers study history to impart Wisdom from its lessons, creating intricate historical narratives depicted through stylized dance moves.

Eclectic Training

The extensive study of a myriad of cultures throughout history exposes a choreographer to a smattering of atypical abilities.

Class Skills

A choreographer can “lose” one of her class skills to gain a skill that does not appear on her class list.

She uses her Wisdom modifier instead of her Charisma modifier on Perform skill checks.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

A choreographer is proficient with all simple weapons and any one additional weapon of her choice. She does not gain proficiency with any armor or shields. When unarmored and unencumbered, a choreographer adds her Wisdom bonus to her AC and her CMD.

These bonuses to AC apply even against touch attacks or when the choreographer is flat-footed.

At 4th level and every four levels thereafter, a choreographer gains a cumulative +1 bonus to AC and CMD up to a maximum of +5 at 20th level.

Spellcasting

A choreographer’s spellcasting ability modifier is Wisdom. At 1st level, she selects one other non-Wisdom-based spellcasting class and adds 1 spell per level of spells she can cast from that class’s list to her list of spells known. These spells do not count against the choreographer’s maximum number of known spells. A choreographer casts these spells as arcane spells.

This alters the bard’s class skills, weapon proficiency, and spellcasting.

Choreographed Dance (Su)

A choreographer practices a stylized form of dance which combines erratic, darting movements, deep lunges and thrusts, dizzying whirls, and athletic leaps to create a theatrical narrative of historical events. At 1st level, she uses Perform (dance) skill to create magical effects on herself.

This works like bardic performance, except as noted here.

The choreographer uses Wisdom, rather than Charisma, to determine how long she can maintain her choreographed dance.
Starting a choreographed dance is a swift action.
The choreographer only affects herself, and does not need to be able to see or hear her own performance.
Choreographed dance is treated as bardic performance for the purposes of feats, abilities, effects, and the like that affect bardic performance, except that choreographed dance does not benefit from the lingering performance feat or any other ability that allows a bardic performance to grant bonuses after it has ended.
Choreographed dance benefits apply only when the choreographer is unarmored and unencumbered. Like bardic performance, it cannot be maintained at the same time as other performance abilities.
Choreographed dance grants a +1 circumstance bonus on attack rolls and melee weapon damage rolls, and a +1 circumstance bonus to AC against attacks of opportunity made as a result of movement. This bonus increases to +2 at 5th level, +3 at 11th level, and +4 at 17th level.

At 3rd level, while maintaining a choreographed dance, a choreographer becomes a whirling frenzy, gaining one extra attack at her highest base attack bonus, a +1 dodge bonus to AC and Reflex saves as if from haste, and a +10 foot bonus to her speed. This dodge bonus and extra attack does not stack with the spell haste or extra attacks from class features such as flurry of blows.

At 15th level, while maintaining a choreographed dance, a choreographer gains two extra attacks at her highest base attack bonus (rather than one).

This ability replaces countersong, distraction, fascinate, inspire competence, and inspire courage.

Versatile Performance (Ex)

At 2nd level, a choreographer can use her bonus in the Perform (dance) skill in place of her bonus in the Acrobatics and Escape Artist skills. Beginning at 6th level, a choreographer gains martial performance, but her choice of Perform type is limited to dance.

This alters versatile performance.

Pursuing Perfection (Ex)

A choreographer studies history’s great philosophers, practicing meditation and balancing techniques which give her the ability to accomplish great things through the use of harnessed supernatural energy.

At 2nd level, a choreographer can select a ninja trick.

Ninja tricks requiring the expenditure of ki points are initiated by expending a number of uses of choreographed dance equal to twice the number of required ki points. The ninja trick’s description dictates what type of action is required to activate the trick, overriding the swift action required to start a choreographed dance.

At 4th level, and every two levels thereafter, a choreographer can select another ninja trick.

At 10th level, a master trick can be selected in place of a ninja trick.

A choreographer cannot select the acceleration of form ninja trick or any ninja tricks that interact with sneak attack, poison, or bombs. This ability counts as the ninja trick class feature.

This replaces well-versed, suggestion, dirge of doom, jack-of-all-trades, inspire greatness, soothing performance, frightening tune, and mass suggestion.

Therapeutic Dance (Su)

At 5th level, a choreographer can expend 2 uses of choreographed dance as a standard action to initiate a therapeutic dance (lasting for 1 round) which simultaneously focuses on defensive movements and balances her body’s vibrations, restoring it to health. Therapeutic dance grants a +4 deflection bonus to AC and produces one of the following restorative effects: • lesser restoration

heals an amount of hit point damage equal to the choreographer‘s level + her Wisdom modifier

At 11th level, the choreographer adds the following to the list of restorative effects she can produce:

neutralize poison
restoration

At 17th level, the restorative effect can remove any one of the following conditions:

fatigued
blinded
deafened
sickened

A choreographer can use therapeutic dance 3 times per day and can generate only one restorative effect at a time with each use of this ability.

This ability replaces lore master.

Unbound Leaps (Ex)

At 9th level, as long as a choreographer has at least 1 round of choreographed dance remaining, she gains light steps as the ninja ability. This effect includes even magically manipulated terrain (such as that affected by entangle) for the choreographer.

At 15th level, a choreographer gains the advanced ninja trick unbound steps.

This replaces inspire heroics.

Lively Performance (Ex)

At 20th level, once per day, when a choreographer would be reduced to 0 or fewer hit points, she can, as a free action, gain the benefits of a breath of life spell, targeting herself.

This replaces deadly performance.
